model.label: Phoenix-MWA (w. Pretrain)
model.checkpoint: 13 post-trained checkpoints at step 20000; task mapping in metadata/training.json
model.trainingSetting: Fine-tuned from pretrained Phoenix-MWA checkpoints; per-group settings in evaluation metadata
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks; 50 episodes per channel; four channels; pooled successful-episode efficiency

protocol.runtimeSnapshot: Evaluation snapshot recorded on 2026-10-19; scene metric contents and hashes attached
protocol.expertReference: All 26 recorded expert_time_step values match the checked official scene snapshot.
protocolChanges: Task09 stage metrics use an axis-corrected offline replay of saved 20 Hz states; SR and other online outcomes are retained. Original online metric frequency was 60 Hz.
Task27 retains the 2026-10-19 object_inside/tolerance=0.22 predicates; the checked current release uses container-local zone predicates for stages, terminal success and drop diagnostics.
Task42 retains stage order banana peel -> paper -> bottle; the checked current release uses paper -> bottle -> banana peel. These historical results were not rescored.

aggregation.sr: Equal mean of four channel success rates for each task, then equal mean across all 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: Mean episode latched stage completion, including failures; equal channel and task weighting.
aggregation.efficiency: For each task, expert_time_step * successful_episode_count / sum(successful steps_to_stable_success), pooled over four channels; equal mean over tasks with success.
aggregation.missing: No-success efficiency is null; overall efficiency reports its valid-task count.
